title: Implement common Document Ingest Layer v0.1
reason: Canon/Continuity, KG curation, research evidence and later persistent character agents need one shared source/provenance substrate. Individual agents should not parse repositories independently or treat document text as canonical truth.
requested_change: Implement the smallest common Document Ingest Layer v0.1 following docs/architecture/DOCUMENT_INGEST_LAYER.md. Add schemas/contracts for source registry, source documents, passages, extracted assertions and interpretation candidates; A0_RAW/A1_EXTRACTED/A2_ACCEPTED/A3_CANONICAL lifecycle metadata; epistemic roles that distinguish narrator assertions, character speech/belief/perception, document claims and system observations; a deterministic Markdown/plain-text repository adapter; version-aware stable fingerprints; duplicate-safe incremental re-ingest; and a bounded review/outbox path for ingest conflicts. Preserve repository commit/blob and passage provenance. Do not directly mutate canon. Include deterministic tests for idempotent unchanged re-ingest, changed-passage detection and the rule that character speech does not automatically become world truth. Keep future DOCX/PDF/upload adapters outside v0.1 but make the contracts extensible.
expected_result: The Ecosystem has a shared, version-aware document source and provenance layer that can ingest registered text-native repository documents into passages, assertions and structured candidates without conflating source statements with accepted or canonical truth, providing a stable substrate for Canon/Continuity and other agents.
